validation.visible_chromium_fixture: passed: existing browser WebSocket-only managed tabs, retained dummy sign-in, actual input recording/replay, persistent socket and disconnect without closing tabs or launching Chrome; dedicated reattachment checks retained

limitations: Actual Windows chrome://inspect permission dialog and operator's signed-in YouTube/Facebook/camera acceptance were not performed by CI.
Normal Chrome connection supports the standard Windows stable Chrome User Data debug marker; other channels/custom roots are not discovered.
Connect my Chrome is required locally after browser/app restart; Chrome permission is never bypassed.
Website sessions may expire; website login and API verification credentials are separate.
Visible workflows require reviewed account-specific recipes; native OBS mouse clicks, file uploads and legacy camera plugins remain unsupported.
Pilot is unsigned; relay hosting and production onboarding/signing gates remain external.
